title: alchemilla vulgaris f. glomerulans
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris f. glomerulans, commonly known as the clustered lady's mantle, is a variant of the lady's mantle plant, known for its distinctive clumping habit. This perennial herb is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, providing relief from digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris f. glomerulans are attributed to its ability to soothe and protect tissues, making it a popular remedy for wound healing and skin conditions. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its health benefits, although further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential.
